constraints.statement: Distinguish empirical findings from expert opinion.

goals.statement: Investigate the main causes of irreproducible results in machine-learning research, synthesize peer-reviewed evidence, distinguish empirical findings from expert opinion, identify disagreements, and propose five testable improvements.

outcomes.description: An investigation of the main causes of irreproducible results in machine-learning research.
A synthesis of peer-reviewed evidence about the causes of irreproducible results in machine-learning research.
A distinction between empirical findings and expert opinion.
An identification of disagreements in the evidence or expert opinion.
Five testable improvements addressing irreproducibility in machine-learning research.

unknowns.question: Which causes qualify as the main causes of irreproducible results in machine-learning research?
Which peer-reviewed studies provide relevant evidence?
Which disagreements are present among the empirical findings and expert opinions?
Which five improvements can be formulated as testable interventions?
